title: Conditional selector law factors by coordinate
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on $\Omega$, let $n$ be a natural number, let $\theta\in[-1,1]$, and fix a vector $a\in\Omega^n$. Sample a second vector independently from $\pi^{\otimes n}$ and, independently at each coordinate, a sign pair whose first sign is uniform and whose second sign agrees with it with probability $(1+\theta)/2$. Use each sign to select between the fixed coordinate of $a$ and the corresponding coordinate of the sampled vector. The resulting law on pairs of output vectors equals the product over coordinates of the one-coordinate law obtained by this procedure with the corresponding fixed value $a_i$.
